notes.title: MegaRace 3 release & language update for MegaRace 1
notes.notes:
Greetings and Happy New Year,

2018 brings us the release of MegaRace 3 on Steam, completing the trilogy that has been missing for too long.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/733770/MegaRace_3/

With the third installment being out, we thought it would be a mega idea to accompany it with a bundle gathering the three games. You can now easily offer your friends these cornerstones of retro-gaming so they can be delighted with Lance Boyle speeches.
And worries not, this bundle allows you to complete your trilogy so you can benefit from the discount as well whether you own only the first game or only the second ; or even the first two maybe?
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5040/MegaRace_Pack/

Earlier in 2017, we also published a patch bringing new languages support to MegaRace 1 for all of you operating it on Windows. You will now be able to launch MegaRace 1 in the following languages :
- English
- French
- Italian
- German
- Spanish
- Brazilian
